component.name: Speak5220
component.summary: Create TMS5220 speech data and build PHROMs

description.p: Speak5220 turns recordings of speech into data for the TMS5220 speech synthesiser, the chip in the BBC Micro's speech upgrade and in many other machines of the early 1980s.

ul.li: Imports WAV files as phrases, and the words of existing Acorn PHROM images
Prepares the audio with a noise gate, bass cut, treble tilt and de-esser
Encodes it to TMS5220 frames, and plays the result through an emulation of the chip
Measures the quality of each phrase, and optimises its settings within a size budget
Exports Acorn PHROM images, C headers, WAV files and a BBC Micro disc that speaks the phrases

description.p: A command-line tool, speak5220-cli, does the same work on project files.
